name: Chilli con Carne

ingredients.name: red kidney beans
ingredients.original: 400 g can red kidney beans, drained and rinsed

steps: Heat a splash of olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Add the beef mince and diced brown onion and cook for 6-8 minutes, breaking up the mince with a wooden spoon, until browned.
Add the crushed garlic, ground cumin, smoked paprika, chilli powder and dried oregano. Stir for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, then add the diced tomatoes and gluten-free beef stock.
Stir in the drained red kidney beans, cover, and simmer on low for 30 minutes, stirring now and then.

Meanwhile, rinse the white rice and put it in a saucepan with 600 ml of water and a pinch of salt. Bring to the boil, cover, turn the heat to low and cook for 12 minutes, then rest off the heat, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Uncover the chilli, season with salt and pepper, and simmer for another 5 minutes until thick and glossy.
Fluff the rice with a fork and serve the chilli spooned over the top.
